integrity: The global upper bound is analytic and strictly unattained; the pointwise optimizer is pre-existing literature and is used solely as an intermediate fact, with an independent derivation. Symbolic tests supplement but do not replace proof. Independent examination is unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for real 3x3 unit-diagonal SPD matrices with two equal positive correlations, comparing spectral condition numbers under positive diagonal congruences. No assertion for general SPD inputs, larger sizes, or practical runtime.
title: The sharp three-halves Jacobi gap on isosceles positive-definite correlation matrices
